memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency.
Symptoms: fatigue, occasional muscle aches; examination: no bony tenderness, normal vitals. Labs show serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 10 ng/mL (low), calcium 9.0 mg/dL, phosphate 3.0 mg/dL. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique: not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks.
